title: Student Misconception Stat
description: Runtime contract for one student's hit count against a single misconception. Stored in the misconception_stats DB table; incremented when the student picks a distractor wired to that misconception.

misconceptionId.description: Misconception ID from the subject library, e.g. 'SAT_RW:transitions-wrong-relation'

hits.description: Number of times the student picked a distractor wired to this misconception

lastHitAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent hit
